text: This report seeks authorization from the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo to engage in discussions with a vendor for the provision of food services at the Toronto Zoo.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about an ongoing negotiation that affects the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo.
